name: Entergy
description: Entergy is a pure-play regulated electric utility holding company: its five operating companies and System Energy deliver electricity to about 3.1 million customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas (including New Orleans) and own about 25,000 MW of generation, about a fifth of it nuclear. It reports one segment, Utility. Rates are set by state and city regulators and FERC, largely through formula rate plans that true up annually with allowed ROE midpoints near 9.7% in Louisiana, so earnings grow as it invests in generation, transmission and distribution. Its growth story is large customer contracts, notably an electric service agreement to serve a Meta Platforms data center in north Louisiana, with customers contributing to the incremental cost to serve. It exited the nonutility nuclear business (Entergy Wholesale Commodities) as a segment before 2023.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Electric Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

hq.note: EDGAR business address New Orleans, LA

businessLines.name: Utility (reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Customers pay regulated retail rates monthly; formula rate plans and riders adjust revenue each year so the company earns a target ROE (about 9.7% midpoint in Louisiana) on its invested rate base, with fuel and purchased power passed through. Large industrial and data-centre customers sign multi-year electric service agreements that include termination payments.
businessLines.description: Generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electric power by Entergy Arkansas, Entergy Louisiana, Entergy Mississippi, Entergy New Orleans, Entergy Texas, plus System Energy (Grand Gulf nuclear, 1,251 MW); the small natural gas distribution businesses of Entergy Louisiana and Entergy New Orleans were sold on July 1, 2025.

geography.method: Regional revenue tagged in the filing's own XBRL instance: full-year contexts with one geographic dimension (or segments named after places), alone or crossed only with operating segments or a revenue line of the income statement; regions must add up to the revenue line within 1 percent; a member equal to the sum of others is a subtotal; the main split is the largest set of members adding up to the total; anything not broken out is a computed remainder.
